What To Expect
Test Execution & Validation
Perform smoke/acceptance tests, automated complete vehicle tests, manual vehicle tests, and simulation tests according to defined specifications.
Load and manage test series in HP-ALM and JIRA.
Conduct breadboard testing and post-tests for identified anomalies.
Test Case Development
Create and maintain test case specifications and scripts using HP-UFT.
Update and verify automated test cases for accuracy and compliance.
Analysis & Documentation
Investigate errors through trace and log analysis.
Document test results, anomalies, and provide detailed reports including screenshots and logs.
Vehicle & Simulation Management
Schedule and manage test vehicles via VDSeasy.
Create and adapt vehicle simulations using SimSim and SimFrog.
Support & Collaboration
Assist with support cases, participate in defect rounds and release meetings.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve user experience and software quality.
 What You Bring Along
Languages: German mandatory and English.
Education: Degree in Automotive Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
Certifications: ISTQB Certified Tester (mandatory).
Technical Skills:
Strong knowledge of diagnostic protocols (CAN, LIN, MOST, FlexRay, Ethernet).
Experience with tools: HP-ALM, HP-UFT, JIRA, CANoe, CAPL, ODIS-E/S, SYSTEM42, TEST42.
Programming skills in C#, .NET, VBScript.
Additional Requirements:
High-voltage awareness for electric vehicles.
Familiarity with VW development and commercial diagnostic testers.
Understanding of ECU communication frameworks and diagnostic interfaces (MCD-3, D-PDU API).
Soft Skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Initiative and innovation mindset to uncover hidden errors and improve processes.
Excellent documentation and communication skills.
